resolution: Reworked the active editor camera to follow the canonical painted-terrain height at its world-space focus while retaining the shared Isometric camera rig and preserving the authored eye-to-target orbit. Added a scalar native height door, cached sampling at camera/event boundaries so overlay projection remains pure, separate terrain-aware placement and navigation planes, cold-load/map-switch re-aiming, and completed-stroke/history notifications with overlay reprojection. Added controller and Zig boundary regressions, regenerated binding catalogs, rebuilt both ReleaseFast editor binaries, and passed the full Zig 0.16 editor gate.
